name: Colossus Cannon
desc: Siege artillery for one. Shells burst on impact, knocking the horde back.

name: Thundercoil Launcher
desc: Coiled lightning orbs that crackle on impact.

name: Serpent SMG
desc: A hissing stream of needles. Never stops talking.

name: Godsbane Rifle
desc: The rifle that killed a god. It remembers.

name: Wraith Bow
desc: Draw to charge; loose hex-bolts that pass through the living.

name: Sunspike Shotgun
desc: A fistful of sunlight at arm's length.

name: Anvil Gauntlets
desc: Short-range shotgun-fists. Punching is the build.

name: Longstrider Rail
desc: High-zoom railgun. Deletes what it can see.

name: Coinshooter
desc: Dual ricochet pistols. Every shot pays twice.

name: Pendulum Repeater
desc: Fire rate accelerates the longer the trigger is held.

name: Bellowfire Projector
desc: A forge-bellows that breathes the furnace at the world.

name: Gravemaw Mortar
desc: Lobs shells that swallow crowds whole.

name: Stormlash
desc: A whip of captured lightning that leaps between the damned.

name: Seraph Lance
desc: A spear of law that never has to be thrown.

name: Tidecaller Harpoon
desc: A drowned god's harpoon. It pulls what it pierces.

name: Orrery Discs
desc: Spinning planetary blades that orbit from foe to foe.

name: Huntmother Javelins
desc: Barbed javelins from a mother who hunts gods.

name: Chorus Harp
desc: Notes that find their audience.

name: Plaguebloom Sprayer
desc: A pressurised fog of the end of things.

name: Dawnbreaker Carbine
desc: Law delivered at 4.5 verdicts per second.

name: Titanfall Hammer
desc: The last hammer of the last smith.

name: Voidheart Singularity
desc: A heart that collapses whatever it touches.

name: Echoing Greatbow
desc: Three arrows. Each remembers the others.

name: Epochal Sundial
desc: Shadows that cut. The hour hand is a blade.
